notes.title: Patch 1 Build Notes
notes.content:
Hello,

Thank you to all our players who have experienced Pine: A Story of Loss so far. We have been working hard addressing bugs, and this patch (v.1.4.12885) has resolved the following issues:

[list]
[*] Fixed some inconsistencies between the animations and subsequent illustrations.
[*] Fixed some missing characters in the Japanese, Korean, Traditional Chinese, and Simplified Chinese translations.
[*] Fixed the subtitle on the start screen being reversed in several languages.
[*] Fixed an occasional softlock in the carving interaction.
[*] Fixed overlapping version numbers on the options menu on the start screen.
[/list]
